comment: Known data_ps3.psarc of each Killzone 2 disc, one entry per disc. US BCUS98116 (VERSION 01.01): hashed on our copy (2026-10-28); Europe BCES00081 (01.01): byte-identical to the US one (2026-11-05); Asia BCAS20066 (01.02) and Japan BCJS30032 (01.00): one copy each (2026-11-05). firstrun_check.py A1: a match with the disc's own entry is OK; another disc's archive is a FAIL (a mixed dump); a mismatch is a WARN unless the entry says fail_on_mismatch (then a FAIL); any other disc is a WARN.
